subject.title: fix(agents): carry current-turn inbound metadata in a tail runtime-context message for byte-stable prompt caching

question: May this PR make the tail runtime-context carrier the permanent fix for current-turn inbound metadata byte-stability?
rationale: The patch preserves context and addresses the source-reproducible cache bug, but it changes the prompt/session layout and provider cache-anchor contract in compatibility-sensitive agent paths.
